artifact_review: The Router identified 'texture_anomaly' in the tub (severity 1.5) and 'structural_collapse' in leg intersections (severity 2.0). I agree with these findings but believe the severity of the structural collapse is underestimated. While the classifier can be confused by unusual angles, predicting a radially symmetric animal (starfish) for a bilaterally symmetric crustacean suggests the AI may have generated ambiguous or morphologically inconsistent features that confuse taxonomic models. This implies a deeper semantic artifact than just 'leg fusion'.
